# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge
We want HouseKeepr to be a welcoming, inclusive, and harassment-free community for everyone who participates.

## Expected behavior
- Be respectful and constructive.
- Assume good intent; ask clarifying questions.
- Keep feedback specific and focused on the work.
- Respect privacy and security; never share secrets (API keys, tokens, service accounts) in issues/PRs.

## Unacceptable behavior
- Harassment, threats, discrimination, or hateful conduct.
- Sexualized language or imagery.
- Doxxing or sharing private information.
- Trolling, personal attacks, or sustained disruption.

## Scope
This code of conduct applies within all project spaces (issues, pull requests, discussions) and also applies when a person is representing the project in public spaces.

## Reporting
If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, please report it privately:
- Prefer GitHub’s built-in reporting / moderation tools when available.
- Otherwise, open a private report by emailing the repository owner/maintainer.

Please do not create a public issue for conduct reports.

## Enforcement
Project maintainers may take any action they deem appropriate, including:
- Removing/editing content
- Temporarily limiting participation
- Banning accounts from project spaces

## Attribution
This document is inspired by common open-source community standards (for example, the Contributor Covenant), adapted for this repository.
